ER26-3650-000        Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. submits tariff filing per 35.13(a)(2)(iii): 2026-08-28_Interconnection Reliability Requirements for Large Loads submitted on 8/28/2026 4:41:03 PM, Filing Type code: 10

Filing Party/Contacts:

Filing Party                             Signer (Representative)                  Other Contact (Principal)               
------------                             -----------------------                  -------------------------               
Minnesota Department of Commerce         AnneMarie.Curtin@state.mn.us                                                     

Basis for Intervening:
The Minnesota Department of Commerce (Commerce) moves to intervene in this proceeding based on the criteria set forth in 18 C.F.R. 385.214(b)(2)(ii)-(iii). Pursuant to Minn. Stat. § 216A.07, subd. 3a, Commerce “has the duty and power to represent the interests of Minnesota residents, businesses, and governments before bodies and agencies outside the state that make, interpret, or implement regional, national, and international energy policy and that regulate and implement regional or national energy planning or infrastructure development.” This proceeding will have a direct impact on energy planning and infrastructure development in Minnesota and involves consumer protections and reliability concerns that are of extreme importance to Minnesota residents, businesses, and governments. Minnesota electric utilities participate in and incur costs related to their participation in the Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc.  Those costs are then recovered from Minnesotan customers. Because Commerce is broadly charged with representing the interests of Minnesotans in matters of energy planning and infrastructure development, it would be in the public interest for Commerce to participate in this proceeding.
